Gabe: Quick sync  We're doing a small CRM tag normalization run at 07:30 PT tomorrow. Purpose: collapse duplicate tags (e.g., 'renewal-risk:high' vs 'renewal_risk=high'), remove stale 'onboard:pending' for accounts with last_activity > 60d, and add a trace tag 'normalized:2955556789'. Dry-run first 200 accounts.
Marta: Will this mutate production rows? Need owner batching and a backup snapshot.
Gabe: Yes writes to prod. Plan: per-owner batches + cs_admin.backups.tag_norm_2955556789 snapshot before each batch. No deletes of primary records, only tag sets and statuses.
Lee: Add guard: skip accounts where manual_tags_lock = true OR is_test_account = true. Also don't overwrite manual_renewal_risk.
Gabe: Added guards. Transformation snippet (preview):
- normalize delimiters to ':'
- map aliases to canonical keys (renewal_risk:high, renewal_risk:medium, renewal_risk:low)
- remove 'onboard:pending' if last_activity > 60d and account_status = 'active'
- append 'normalized:2955556789' to tags
ops-bot: Task created: CS-9802 "CRM tag normalization (owner-batched)" assigned to Gabe. Window 07:30-08:15 PT.
Marta: Rollback plan? We need a fast revert path.
Gabe: Rollback: restore per-owner from cs_admin.backups.tag_norm_2955556789; we also upload changed_ids CSV to admin-s3/tagnorm/2955556789.csv. Will post start/finish counts here and open a quick incident if >500 changes/min.
Lee: I'll monitor playbook fire-rate and webhook queue. If anything spikes I'll trigger the rollback.
Gabe: Kicking off dry-run at 07:30. Will post sample output and intended SQL in 5m.
